payload.description:
Purpose: add the household computer without putting browser readiness in front of the model loop.

Definition of Done:
- Cold readiness gates are measured and recorded.
- Concurrent demand starts at most one host for a computer.
- A bot performs useful computerless work before reporting a truthful capability wait.
- The first computer tool continues the same durable turn exactly once.
- Failure at every escalation boundary neither loses the turn nor creates simultaneous actors.
- Dead or wedged computer ownership expires without an always-on scheduler.
payload.title: Summon one computer and continue the same turn
